BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to private residential fire sprinklers; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) The state building code council shallform a technical advisory group to research and review policies andprocedures for residential fire sprinklers. (b) The purpose of the study is to research obstacles and barriersto the installation of residential fire sprinkler systems. (2) The technical advisory group must consist of: (a) Representatives from: A city association, a countyassociation, the association of building officials, an association ofspecial purpose watersewer districts, and a public utility districtassociation; (b) A fire chief, a state licensed residential fire sprinklercontractor, an architect, and a residential builder; and (c) Any other representative deemed necessary to develop the modelpolicy. (3) The state building code council shall report the findings of p. 1 ESHB 2292the technical advisory group to the appropriate committees of thelegislature by January 15, 2008.
